warning_texts: analysis/answers/R04.json caveats[0] explains the AOV difference causally, through a customer trait the data does not measure. Until it is removed, this sentence should not reach the release (see blocking issue CLAIMS-AUD-R04-CAUSAL).

H-CHANNEL-AOV compares only delivered orders, and delivery rates differ by channel (direct 0.724397, partner 0.604746). The AOV gap therefore describes the channels' delivered baskets, not the channels' order values as placed, and any text built on R04 should say so.

The confounder check found no Simpson reversal. Channel mix is about 55 percent direct in every country (CZ, DE, PL) and every month (2026-01..03). The direct-minus-partner completion gap is positive in every stratum (0.108 to 0.130), and so is the AOV gap (21.91 to 24.93 EUR). Country and month do

Both registered tests declare Bonferroni, but the claims record only the nominal alpha 0.05, which matches the plan, with no adjusted alpha. The per-test threshold would be 0.025. Both p values are below 1e-10, so the conclusion does not change, but the correction is named rather than shown.

CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV has only the registered-direction caveat. It does not say the compared values are delivered orders net of refunds; the plan's H-CHANNEL-AOV assumptions do. No rule requires this, but a reader of the test alone lacks the population.

No deterministic rule in check_plan.json checks the wording of analysis/answers/*.json (causal language, extra caveats) or whether the delivered and net-of-refund facts appear in AOV caveats. Both blockers above sit in that unchecked area and were found only by this review.
summary: I recomputed all eight claims from quarantine/orders.csv (last revision per order_id, order_month in 2026-01..2026-03, refund_amount >= 0; 44531 orders). Every value, bound, n, statistic, p and effect matches the metrics registry and the machine gate. The claim-to-metric-to-plan chain has no gaps, R01-R05 are present and the test claims match the plan. No free text from the comment column is in the register or the answers. The gate's claims_recomputed is rooted in raw_data/. There are no Simpson reversals by country or month. Two blockers on worker_analysis. (1) analysis/answers/R04.json cavea
